title.en: Add explicit CubeCL dual compiler probe

intent.zh: 核对Windows工具链，实现同核双路探针。
intent.en: Pin CubeCL source and implement explicit Cpp/Llvm probes without changing the default Rust toolchain or claiming unrun acceptance.

acceptance: Use the frozen CubeCL commit and record dependency licences.
Use one Rust kernel with explicit Cpp and Llvm route selection.
Keep the native probe and no-CPU-fallback behavior.
Run available Rust checks and record real Windows GPU results or concrete toolchain blockers.
Keep Linux and engine equivalence acceptance pending.
note:
Windows C++ compiler probe passes. LLVM source remains uncompiled: MSVC/link.exe absent; elevation was rejected by policy. Linux and P1 complete acceptance stay pending. Only task-related files will enter the first Git commit.
First task-scoped Git commit recorded. C++ Windows: 15 Rust tests pass; one GPU test covers six lengths; maximum 1048576 elements and three changed-input graph replays pass. Native GPU tests: two pass. fmt/clippy/docs and three PowerShell parsers pass. LLVM code is not compiled: missing MSVC/link.exe and blocked elevation. Linux/deployment/physics/P1 complete acceptance remain pending. Keep all modules planned and all 141 target contracts unimplemented.
